mapper.sql: select h.recalc_hist_id as "recalcHistId", h.job_id as "jobId", h.target_user_id as "targetUserId", case when k.name is not null then k.name else u.login_id end as "targetUserName", h.evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", h.formula_version_id as "formulaVersionId", h.target_scope as "targetScope", h.changed_count as "changedCount", h.before_total_score as "beforeTotalScore", h.after_total_score as "afterTotalScore", h.executed_at as "executedAt", h.request_id as "requestId" from biz_recalc_hist h join users u on u.user_id = h.target_user_id left join korus_personnel_snapshots k on k.employee_no = u.employee_no

where.if: and h.executed_at < (cast(#{criteria.normalizedExecutedTo} as date) + interval '1 day')

mapper.select: order by h.evaluation_year desc, h.executed_at desc, h.recalc_hist_id limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}
mapper.insert: insert into business_process_audit_logs (action_type, target_key, before_state, after_state, actor_user_id, result_status, request_id, created_at) values ('BATCH', #{targetKey}, null, cast(#{afterStateJson} as jsonb), #{actorUserId}, 'SUCCESS', #{requestId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
